content.text: Digital creators in regions where Stripe and PayPal are inaccessible face significant challenges in setting up online stores. Countries like Nigeria, Venezuela, and Zimbabwe often experience stringent restrictions that hinder the ability to accept [[LINK:https://[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/coremerch-sovereign-stack-deployment-guide-what-nobody-tells-24|COREMERCH guide to coremerch]].github.io/store/blog/[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-gateways-cameroon-digital-products-minimum-viable-stack-5|Payment Gateways]]-options-ethiopian-digital-creators-trap-most-creators-2|payment]]s. COREMERCH offers a solution with Stack 02 on Cloudflare Pages, providing a robust, tested infrastructure that allows you to sell digital products seamlessly while bypassing these limitations.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The infrastructure provided by COREMERCH is designed to empower creators by circumventing the barriers set by conventional payment platforms. Stack 02 harnesses the power of Cloudflare Pages, Workers, and NOWPayments to provide a reliable and decentralized way of handling digital transactions. Unlike traditional systems that can impose strict regulations and fees, this stack allows creators to maintain full ownership of their digital commerce. When payment platforms fail due to regional restrictions, this architecture ensures that your store remains operational, allowing for uninterrupted service and income. The focus on sovereignty in digital commerce means that you are not at the mercy of external platforms.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying your digital store on Cloudflare Pages, ensure you have the essential tools and accounts set up. You will need a Cloudflare account to utilize their Pages service, as well as a Google account to access Google Apps Script for backend logic. Additionally, sign up for a NOWPayments account to integrate cryptocurrency payment processing seamlessly. Prepare your digital products, ensuring they are ready for upload. Familiarize yourself with the Sovereign Blueprint documentation, which provides detailed steps for deploying your store efficiently. With these elements in place, you're set to begin the deployment process.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Setting up the payment and delivery pipeline is critical for a smooth customer experience. Begin by deploying your backend logic using Google Apps Script, which will handle order processing and storage of data. Next, configure NOWPayments to accept various cryptocurrencies, ensuring you select networks that minimize transaction fees. Integrate this payment system with your Cloudflare Pages setup to enable instant payment confirmations. Finally, utilize tools like Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery, ensuring that your customers receive their digital products promptly after purchase. This streamlined setup guarantees a quick and efficient transaction process.
Cut out platform fees and control your revenue streams.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your digital store is set up, it’s time to go live. Publish your Cloudflare Pages site and conduct thorough testing to ensure everything functions as intended. Place a test order to verify that the payment processing works seamlessly through NOWPayments, and that customers receive their products without delays. Monitor the backend for any issues during this initial transaction. Once confirmed successful, you are ready to start promoting your digital store. Share your store link widely, leveraging social media and other platforms to reach potential customers.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

After successfully launching your digital store, consider strategies for scaling your operations. Begin by analyzing customer feedback to identify areas for improvement in your product offerings and user experience. You can expand the number of products available for sale, leveraging the scalability of your Cloudflare Pages setup. Utilize analytics tools to monitor traffic and sales data, helping you make informed decisions on marketing efforts. As you grow, consider integrating additional features like email marketing or customer relationship management tools to enhance customer engagement and retention.
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

The setup sequence matters because each component depends on the previous one being correctly configured. Start with NOWPayments: create your account, configure wallet addresses for each coin you want to accept, generate the API key, and note the IPN secret key you will set. Then configure the backend: in Stack 01, deploy the Google Apps Script Web App and note its URL; in Stack 02, deploy the Cloudflare Worker and note its URL. Set that URL as the webhook endpoint in your NOWPayments IPN settings. Then configure the storefront. Then run a real mainnet test — send actual crypto to your configured wallet address, confirm NOWPayments detects it, confirm the webhook fires, and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link.

Both result in the same ownership structure: your GitHub or Cloudflare account, your Supabase database, your NOWPayments account, your wallet, your store. See both options at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

1. Create a Cloudflare account to access Pages. 2. Set up a Google account for Apps Script integration. 3. Register for a NOWPayments account for crypto processing. 4. Prepare your digital products for upload. 5. Review the Sovereign Blueprint documentation for deployment guidance. 6. Deploy your backend logic using Google Apps Script. 7. Configure NOWPayments for seamless payment processing. 8. Use Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for product delivery. 9. Publish your Cloudflare Pages site. 10. Test the payment process and confirm transactions work correctly. 11. Promote your digital store to attract customers.

What is the difference between Stack 01 and Stack 02 in COREMERCH?

Yes, you can host a digital product store on both GitHub Pages and Cloudflare Pages. However, for enhanced functionality and better performance, Cloudflare Pages is recommended, especially when combined with their Workers for backend processing.
What payment options are available through NOWPayments?

NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, allowing you to accept a wide range of digital currencies. With low fees and no KYC requirements, it provides a flexible payment solution tailored for creators.
